create_SequenceBatch_packed: create a SequenceBatch with packed sequences and sequence lengths for efficient batched training
create_SequenceBatch_unpacked: create a SequenceBatch with padded 2D sequences and per-example length list for standard batching
as_auto_regressive_SequenceBatch: call as_auto_regressive on a SequenceBatch to get input and target batches shifted by one token
create_Seq2SeqBatch: create a Seq2SeqBatch with source and target sequences plus their lengths for sequence-to-sequence training
as_auto_regressive_Seq2SeqBatch: call as_auto_regressive on a Seq2SeqBatch to get source-target input and target-only batches for training
